q: The Blahut-Arimoto algorithm computes channel capacity by alternately optimising the input distribution and the channel's backward probabilities. Its convergence is guaranteed because it:
opts: Is an EM algorithm (expectation-maximization), converging to the capacity achieving distribution
exp: Blahut-Arimoto is an instance of the EM algorithm: it alternates between computing the backward channel (E-step) and optimising the input distribution (M-step). Each iteration increases the mutual information, and convergence to capacity is guaranteed (though rate may be slow near capacity).
